title: Late Night Crispy Portuguese Fish Wrapped
description: Citrusy fish wrapped in crispy lotus leaf for a midnight craving, using pressure-cooked fish-sauce aekjeot and following Whole30 guidelines.
instructions: Prepare the lotus leaf wraps by washing and drying them.
Season the cod fillets with Himalayan pink salt and set aside.
Mix together the freshly squeezed lime juice, fish sauce, ginger paste, and galangal paste for the marinade.
Marinate the cod fillets in the mixture for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a pressure cooker to high pressure and cook the cod fillets for 8 minutes.
While the fish is cooking, heat the avocado oil in a pan over medium heat.
Once the fish is cooked, remove it from the pressure cooker and set aside to cool.
Using the same pan, add the garlic paste and cook until fragrant.
Add the cooked cod fillets to the pan and wrap each one in a lotus leaf wrap.
Serve immediately and garnish with fresh cilantro.
Crisp up the lotus leaf wraps in a pan over medium heat for 1-2 minutes on each side.
